scope:
Reusable Make-derived SH-4 compilation and disabled byte-identity gate.

The default matrix qualifies Build35. --config accepts the same JSON shape as
--print-config for later isolated builds. Every changed existing translation
unit is compiled from the archived integration tree and current source with
new controls absent and explicitly zero. Complete preprocessed files and
objects must match byte for byte. Enabled arms compile production source and
perform a relocatable link; this does not build a whole game or prove visuals.
Debug records and preprocessor line markers are consistently omitted. No game
data, console, emulator, target cache timing or full-image PASS is claimed.

size_scope.controls: Same public QA/DFA/FA29 recipe with new controls disabled at the archived integration baseline; sizes sum selected target-object sections, not a final linked game image.
size_scope.complete_feature_arms: gaps and combined cover all ten changed existing TUs, with the new window TU included only in combined.
size_scope.window_bounds: window-one and window-max cover only QA/DFA/FA29/window TUs; no additional code-size claim is made for their uncompiled gap-hook TUs.
size_scope.alternate_feature_arms: gaps-scalar and gaps-compare use different existing feature settings. Their absolute sizes/frames remain in artifacts; no delta against the normal recipe is presented.
size_scope.stack: Maximum local compiler-reported frame per TU; not a whole call-chain or IRQ stack peak.
